title: Stop Waiting To Be Chosen | The Psychology of Taking Control - Inner Work

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱，还能赚取其他收益，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和持续的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了这个项目，此后也一直陪伴并支持着两届心理学家走过这段旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我个人的独家支持套餐，不收取任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场群组头脑风暴、大师班、个性化指导、一份福南梅森的零食礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 点击简介中链接的我的福利页面，了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《内在工作》。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being here.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的收听。

sentences.en: Let's think then about, you know, whether we are going to start taking control, whether we're going to continue to wait to be chosen.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们来思考一下，你知道的，我们是打算开始掌控自己的生活，还是继续等待被选择。

sentences.en: This can crop up in so many areas of our lives.
sentences.zh: 这种情况可能会出现在我们生活的方方面面。

sentences.en: And this was evoked for me in the conversation I had with Cliff Hawkins.
sentences.zh: 我和克利夫·霍金斯的对话让我深有感触。

sentences.en: I think it can be really important to think about coming up with a bit of a goals list, really.
sentences.zh: 我认为，列出一份目标清单其实非常重要。

sentences.en: What are your goals?
sentences.zh: 你的目标是什么？

sentences.en: You know, we can't have probably 10 or 15 goals.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们大概不能有10个或15个目标。

sentences.en: We were allowed to have kind of one personal goal, one professional goal, and one, you know, work-life balance goal.
sentences.zh: 我们只被允许有一个个人目标、一个职业目标，以及一个，你知道的，工作与生活平衡的目标。

sentences.en: If you were supposed to, if you were going to think about those three goals, what would they look like for you?
sentences.zh: 如果你去想这三个目标，对你来说它们会是什么样的？

sentences.en: And, yeah, how can you start to be able to begin to take a little bit of more control, a little bit more intention towards having that goal happen?
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，你如何才能开始掌控多一点，为实现这个目标付出更多的一点意图？

sentences.en: And, you know, Cliff's idea was actually reaching out to people, you know, asking people for meetings, asking for people's time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，克利夫的想法实际上是主动联系别人，你知道的，邀请别人开会，占用别人的时间。

sentences.en: And then, of course, they can only say no.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，他们最多也就是拒绝。

sentences.en: All it makes you look is conscientious.
sentences.zh: 这只会让你看起来很有责任心。

sentences.en: And people do reach out to me all the time to ask me things.
sentences.zh: 人们确实总是联系我来问我各种事情。

sentences.en: Sometimes I'm in a position where I'm able to help, drop them a little bit of advice.
sentences.zh: 有时我能帮上忙，给他们提一点建议。

sentences.en: Other times they might be looking for work and I'm not recruiting.
sentences.zh: 有时他们可能在找工作，而我并不在招人。

sentences.en: But, you know, how can you kind of empower yourself to start moving your life forward in the direction that would make you happy?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，你该如何赋能自己，让生活朝着能让你快乐的方向前进呢？

sentences.en: I would love to know your thoughts.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你的想法。

sentences.en: And I think that can be really difficult.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这真的很难。

sentences.en: Sometimes having that self-belief, having what kind of Maslow's hierarchy would think about as self-actualization.
sentences.zh: 有时拥有那种自信，拥有马斯洛需求层次理论中所认为的自我实现。

sentences.en: So at the top of Maslow's hierarchy would be the self-actualizing phase.
sentences.zh: 因此，马斯洛需求层次的顶端就是自我实现阶段。

sentences.en: And I think it often is linked to what we've had before as to whether we think of ourselves as the kind of person who can go out there and be a go-getter, get what you want.
sentences.zh: 我认为这往往与我们过往的经历有关，即我们是否认为自己是那种敢于走出去、做个行动派、争取自己想要的东西的人。

sentences.en: Would you feel like you deserved that?
sentences.zh: 你会觉得你配得上那些吗？

sentences.en: Would you feel like others might come along and take that away?
sentences.zh: 你会不会觉得别人可能会出现并把它们夺走？

sentences.en: And it's being able to work through some of that distress.
sentences.zh: 这就是克服这种焦虑的过程。

sentences.en: But to know that if you don't try and create some of that agency for yourself, that others,
sentences.zh: 但你要明白，如果你不尝试为自己争取一些主动权，那么其他人——

sentences.en: who may not even be as strong a candidate as you or strong at whatever it is you're trying to pursue,
sentences.zh: 他们可能甚至不如你优秀，或者不如你所追求的事情那么擅长——

sentences.en: may get there because they are better at raising their hand and asking for help.
sentences.zh: 可能会捷足先登，因为他们更擅长举手表达和寻求帮助。

sentences.en: It's that idea of nobody is coming to save you, which is really hard because can't they just come and save us?
sentences.zh: 这就是那种“没有人会来拯救你”的想法，这真的很艰难，因为难道他们就不能来拯救我们吗？

sentences.en: Wouldn't that be easier?
sentences.zh: 那样不是更容易吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, you've got to be able to empower yourself to do that.
sentences.zh: 是的，你必须赋能自己去做到这一点。

sentences.en: And I have to do that with myself, reaching out to people to kind of think about partnership working and kind of sponsorship.
sentences.zh: 我自己也必须这样做，主动联系他人，考虑合作和赞助事宜。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it isn't easy, but we have to, you have to sometimes have the difficult conversations to be able to get ourselves where we want to go.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这并不容易，但为了到达我们想去的地方，有时我们必须进行艰难的对话。

sentences.en: I would love your thoughts on this.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你对这件事的看法。

sentences.en: How can you be bold?
sentences.zh: 你该如何变得大胆？

sentences.en: How can you be brave?
sentences.zh: 你该如何变得勇敢？

sentences.en: How can you move yourself closer to your goals?
sentences.zh: 你该如何让自己更接近目标？

sentences.en: I would love to know.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你在场。

sentences.en: I will be back along with the next episode of Inner Work next week.
sentences.zh: 我将于下周带着下一期《内在工作》节目回归。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。
